data.name: GENV_001
data.value: Before the forests. Before the rivers. Before the first beat of a wing… there was this.

data.name: GENV_002
data.value: Stone, and silence. A world perfectly still — and perfectly dead.

data.name: GENV_003
data.value: Nothing was born. Nothing died. There was nothing for it.

data.name: GENV_005
data.value: Small. Smaller than you. Alone in all that emptiness.

data.name: GENV_006
data.value: No one knows where it came from. Perhaps from nowhere. Perhaps it had always been there, waiting.

data.name: GENV_007
data.value: It did not speak. It did not command. It *danced*.

data.name: GENV_008
data.value: With every step of its dance, something was born.

data.name: GENV_009
data.value: That which swims. That which flies. That which digs. That which burns, that which freezes, that which dreams.

data.name: GENV_010
data.value: None resembled it. That was the point.

data.name: GENV_011
data.value: It did not want a world in its own image. It wanted a world that would surprise it.

data.name: GENV_012
data.value: But a dance does not last forever.

data.name: GENV_013
data.value: So before leaving, it left something behind.

data.name: GENV_014
data.value: Hearts. Buried in the rock, at the bottom of the seas, beneath the roots. One for every region of the world.

data.name: GENV_015
data.value: As long as a Heart beats, its region can sustain life. It is she who continues to dance, through them.

data.name: GENV_016
data.value: That is where you come from. That is where *everything* comes from.

data.name: GENV_017
data.value: And that is why what you saw in those ruins keeps me awake at night.

data.name: GENV_018
data.value: That which sustains life… can also be drained.
